turns.description: Our object storage service is failing GET, LIST, PUT, and DELETE requests across our eastern US region, with dependent compute, block-storage, and serverless services also affected. The disruption began this morning, shortly after 9:37 AM PST. Just before the disruption, one of our engineers executed a standard playbook command intended to remove a small number of servers from a subsystem used by our billing process.

turns.analyst_answer: Our object storage service is affected. Other services that depend on it are also experiencing problems. GET, LIST, PUT, and DELETE requests are failing. We're also seeing problems with new compute instance launches, block-storage volumes that need data from object storage snapshots, serverless computing, and the object storage console. We can't update individual service statuses through our health dashboard administration console either.
